classification_rule: Inventory classification describes extraction/reuse potential, never Shelf admission or certification.

notes: Generic schema/config surface exists.
Embedded self-test and Stable UI label do not constitute trusted admission evidence.
Generic configuration/search/filter/sort/export surface exists.
In-memory data and development status limit production use.
Bearer authentication, path/tool permission checks and identity loading are BORIS-runtime infrastructure.
They are not a general application auth/profiles/households/organizations block.
Portable named-agent identity/provenance must remain preserved.
It must not be relabelled as an end-user identity block.
Durable scheduled task behavior exists inside BORIS runtime and storage.
No stable application scheduling Module interface or independent receipt exists.
postMessage port delivery/acknowledgement exists for the static workbench.
It is local browser coordination, not network realtime synchronization or notifications.
Provider-neutral runtime interface with OpenAI and Anthropic implementations exists.
It is coupled to BORIS task execution and is not yet an application AI Gateway block.
Typed storage contracts and SQLite implementation cover tasks, evidence, approvals, events, schedules and memory.
The schema is BORIS-domain-specific and not a generic CRUD/backend block.
Event persistence, worker and schedule primitives exist.
No stable analytics/events, audit-log or background-jobs block contract has been extracted.
Responsive cards, tokens and controls recur as embedded CSS.
No canonical design-token/component block exists; extraction requires Design Director review and real visual/accessibility evidence.
Canonical Factory Core Quality Gate and trusted evidence boundary are operational Phase 5 control-plane capabilities.
Core capabilities are searchable but are not relabelled as Blocks or self-admitted Shelf assets.
BORIS deployment and CI patterns exist.
They require application-specific environment wiring and do not prove Vercel/VPS adapter portability.
Compatibility remains preserved.
Council-first routing is superseded by the five permanent roles and must not become a Shelf asset.
No existing combination has a stable multi-Block interface and admission evidence.
No Module was manufactured for Phase 6.
Family OS, Business OS, Tutor and AI Kiosk are concepts only in this repository.
No evidence-backed Blueprint was created and Michel OS was not inspected.
